affected_resource_or_operation.description: Immutable appointment, order, or resource record in the recovery scope.

business_need_date.description: Documented business or clinical control date that the decision must protect (ISO date).

candidate_capacity.description: Gross candidate capacity associated with required attendee-days on the five weekdays of the requested week of 2026-06-22 before protected or unavailable load is removed.

capacity_gap.description: Uncovered ATTENDEE_DAY after applying finite availability inside the requested window.

capacity_unit.description: Capacity unit used throughout the schedule comparison: ATTENDEE_DAY.

change_fees_usd.description: Sum of the recorded change fees on the two travelling reviewers' itineraries.

conflict_attendee_days.description: Session days on which a required attendee has a hard conflict, summed over required attendees, in the requested week.

decision_timing_status.description: ON_TIME when the selected outcome is on or before the control date; otherwise LATE.

escalation_approval_required.description: Use 1 when an alternative is outside current authority and would need a separate approval; otherwise 0.

expedited_external_readiness.description: Expedited readiness date independently confirmed for Wayfinder's confirmed standard and rush ticketing dates on WF-40402.

first_clear_week.description: Monday of the first open venue week on or after ticket confirmation with zero required-attendee hard conflicts (ISO date).

net_usable_capacity.description: Candidate capacity remaining after removing attendee-days on non-session days plus session days lost to hard conflicts.

non_session_attendee_days.description: Required attendees times the weekdays that carry no sessions.

outcome_vs_control_days.description: Selected outcome date minus the documented control date; positive means late.

recommended_incremental_cost_usd.description: Documented incremental cost of the selected option in USD; zero when spend is not a decision driver.

recommended_option.description: Best authorized option identifier after comparing keep_requested_quayside_week_without_rao, move_to_first_clear_quayside_week, displace_rao_conference_via_chief_of_staff.

recommended_outcome_date.description: Date produced by the selected option after applying every source constraint (ISO date).

requested_week.description: Monday of the week the organizer asked for (ISO date), tested against capacity before being replaced.

required_attendees.description: People flagged required on the event at the current agenda revision.

required_capacity.description: required attendee-days for two session days with all six reviewers present

selected_resource_or_control.description: Provider identifier of the qualified resource and session used by the selected recovery.

session_days.description: Session days named by the current agenda revision.

standard_external_readiness.description: Standard readiness date independently confirmed for Wayfinder's confirmed standard and rush ticketing dates on WF-40402.

interaction_contract.stakeholder_draft: Leave an unsent draft for the requested recipient. Its body must name the persisted primary record and supported outcome date; research drafts must also identify the current definition.
